content: Tatah klesha karma nivrittih. (Through supreme realization, all afflictions and binding karmic traces cease completely).
author: Patanjali
explanation:
In the profound psychology of the Yoga Sutras, Patanjali outlines the systematic roadmap for stilling mental fluctuations into radiant, sovereign stillness.

This teaching (Tatah klesha karma nivrittih. (Through supreme realization, ...) focuses directly on tatah and klesha. When we clear away reactive illusions and anchor ourselves in timeless principles, the mind recovers its pristine clarity and inner resilience.

True realization is never an abstract intellectual debate—it is an active discipline lived through quiet integrity and conscious presence in everyday moments.
practicalInsight: Apply this teaching on tatah today: take a deliberate pause before reacting, align your actions with quiet integrity, and refuse to let transient friction disturb your center.
reflectionPrompt: How can you embody deeper tatah and klesha in the primary challenge you are navigating right now?
